records.notes: Unit Volume defined as total sales of food/beverages/merchandise/services to customers including off-site and catering, less taxes and refunds. Data includes 2,606 Traditional Franchised Restaurants (operating >360 days during measurement period); excluded 583 outlets open <361 days, 8 without designated POS system, 13 non-traditional venues, and 17 company-owned/affiliate-owned.
